tips.title: Set up one cleaner-air room
tips.action: Pick one room, close it off, and run a correctly sized air purifier there on smoky or high-AQI days
tips.why: One well-filtered room gives you a place to breathe cleaner air when the whole home cannot be filtered
tips.caution: Keep the room cool enough in hot weather. A purifier does not remove all gases.

notes.IN: Useful during winter smog in many north Indian cities.

hi.title: घर में एक साफ़ हवा वाला कमरा बनाएँ
hi.action: धुएँ या ज़्यादा AQI वाले दिनों में एक कमरा बंद करें और उसमें सही आकार का एयर प्यूरीफ़ायर चलाएँ
hi.why: जब पूरे घर की हवा साफ़ न हो सके, तब एक कमरा साँस लेने के लिए साफ़ जगह देता है

tips.title: Keep a simple blood pressure log
tips.action: Write down each home reading with the date and time, and bring the log to your next appointment
tips.why: A written record shows your doctor a pattern, not one reading on one day
tips.caution: Seek urgent care for a very high reading with symptoms such as chest pain or weakness.

tips.title: Learn the signs of heat illness
tips.action: Before a hot day, read the warning signs of heat exhaustion and heat stroke, and know what to do for each
tips.why: Heat illness can get worse quickly, and early action prevents harm
tips.caution: Heat stroke is an emergency. Call for help at once.

edges.why: A cleaner-air room works only with a purifier sized for that room.
Both reduce the smoke you breathe at home.
A log turns single readings into a trend.
Planning around heat and knowing the warning signs work together.
